## 1. Third-party components distributed with the application

Every component is **included in the repository** and served from the same
origin: the application loads no code from external CDNs at runtime. That is
what makes it usable offline and what removes any dependence on third-party
availability.

| Component | Version/File | Licence | Size | Role |
|---|---|---|---:|---|
| **RDKit MinimalLib (JS glue)**<br><sub>RDKit / Greg Landrum</sub> | `RDKit_minimal.js` | BSD-3-Clause | 125 kB | Cheminformatics: SMILES and SMARTS parsing, descriptors, 2D drawing. |
| **RDKit MinimalLib (WebAssembly)**<br><sub>RDKit / Greg Landrum</sub> | `RDKit_minimal.wasm` | BSD-3-Clause | 6753 kB | WebAssembly binary of the cheminformatics engine. |
| **three.js**<br><sub>mrdoob e collaboratori</sub> | `three.min.js` | MIT | 589 kB | WebGL rendering engine for the 3D scenes. |
| **three.js — UnrealBloomPass**<br><sub>mrdoob e collaboratori</sub> | `three_bloom.js` | MIT | 25 kB | Post-processing effect for the astronomical visualisations. |
| **three.js — GLTFLoader**<br><sub>mrdoob e collaboratori</sub> | `gltf_loader.js` | MIT | 94 kB | Loading of anatomical and molecular models in glTF format. |
| **3Dmol.js**<br><sub>University of Pittsburgh / David Koes</sub> | `3Dmol-min.js` | BSD-3-Clause | 502 kB | 3D molecular visualisation (PDB, SDF, surfaces). |
| **SmilesDrawer**<br><sub>Daniel Probst</sub> | `smiles-drawer.min.js` | MIT | 246 kB | 2D structure drawing from SMILES. |
| **PDF.js (build legacy)**<br><sub>Mozilla Foundation</sub> | `vendor/pdfjs/pdf.min.mjs` | Apache-2.0 | 511 kB | Opening PDF documents in the spectrum reader: every page drawn and its text layer. It is the legacy build, because the default one uses very recent language features and breaks on browsers that do not have them yet. |
| **PDF.js — worker**<br><sub>Mozilla Foundation</sub> | `vendor/pdfjs/pdf.worker.min.mjs` | Apache-2.0 | 1290 kB | The PDF decoding work, off the main thread: a complex page does not freeze the interface. |
| **sql.js (JS glue)**<br><sub>sql.js / SQLite</sub> | `lib/sql-wasm.js` | MIT | 45 kB | In-browser SQLite database for the data exercises. |
| **SQLite (WebAssembly)**<br><sub>SQLite Consortium</sub> | `lib/sql-wasm.wasm` | Public Domain | 644 kB | SQLite engine compiled to WebAssembly. |
| **Dataset dimuoni (CERN Open Data)**<br><sub>CERN Open Data Portal</sub> | `lib/dimuon.js` | CC0-1.0 | 48 kB | Experimental data for the particle-physics exercise. |
| **Modello 3D «Noir» (Skyfox13, Sketchfab)**<br><sub>Skyfox13 — https://sketchfab.com/podderkuntal25</sub> | `models/spectra-noir.glb` | CC-BY-4.0 | 8154 kB | Spectra's face in the Spectra Live console. Modified: textures recompressed, tangents removed, face in dark grey metal, mouth and head animated. Credited in the console. |

## 3. Development dependencies

Used **only** to run the verification benches. They are not distributed with
the application and are not present in production.

| Package | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `playwright-core` | 1.62.1 | Apache-2.0 |

---

## 4. Runtime dependencies

**None.** The application has no backend, installs no package at runtime and
loads no script from external domains. The only network calls are optional and
go to documented public services:

| Service | Purpose | If unreachable |
|---|---|---|
| PubChem PUG-REST | IUPAC name, CAS, GHS pictograms, 3D conformers | the app uses local data and says so |
| NASA / ESA | astronomical images and data | the module shows the tabulated data |
| AI providers (user's choice) | assistant answers | the assistant reports it and offers alternatives |

No personal data is transmitted: API keys, if entered, stay in the device's
`localStorage`, or on the user's own proxy (see `proxy/`).
